cases.rationale: The whole crop shows multiple actual flying kites with suspended bodies and strings above the water, recognizable boats along the far water edge, and small actual people gathered along the right bank. The airborne shapes have kite structure and are not actual birds or airplanes. The white rectangles on the near bank are sign-like panels rather than identifiable benches. I considered each of the 75 frozen definitions; no other defined object is visible and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A man in a shirt and actual black necktie holds a plate and an eating spoon, whose rounded bowl is visible at the food. A curved black chair back appears at the right edge. The pale topped food with a brown base could be cake, but the small soft detail does not distinguish cake from another dessert, so cake is unclear. The flat plate is not a bowl, and the utensil does not show fork tines or a knife blade. All 75 definitions were considered; no additional category ambiguity remains.

Several actual people stand beside an unmistakable yellow road bus with its passenger windows and doorway visible. The handled white carrier bags being carried at lower right have tote-bag structure, supporting handbag under the supplied carried-tote definition. They are not rigid suitcases or backpacks. The horizontal rail and foreground surfaces are not identifiable benches or dining tables. I considered every frozen definition; no other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

Two actual open laptops show integrated screens, bases, and visible keyboard keys. A small black wired computer mouse sits between the machines near the cables. The integrated screens count as laptop rather than standalone TV, and the working desk is not a dining table. Cables and small desk items do not identify another listed object. Each of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual people sit and stand at a bar. The counter holds narrow-necked bottles, stemmed wine-glass forms, and recognizable handleless drinking glasses including a pint glass. A phone with a dark screen and handset body lies at the front edge. The broad reflective surface is a bar counter, excluded from dining table, and the hanging shades are lamps rather than umbrellas. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered; no additional listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

An actual black cat stands on the cushioned upholstered sofa at left. At right is a distinct single-person wicker armchair with a high back and arms; loose fabric on it does not make it a bed. Small stacked rectangular items on the upper-right sill may be bound books, but their spines/pages are too indistinct to distinguish books from other stacked objects, so book is unclear. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no other unresolved category identity is supported.

Actual baseball-uniformed people occupy a long green bench, with a child hanging from the fence. A tan leather fielding mitt with its finger-pocket shape is visible near the hanging child's right hip, supporting baseball glove independently of the sporting context. The long red hanging equipment case is not identifiable as a backpack or rigid suitcase. The bench is not an individual chair. I considered all 75 definitions and found no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual freestanding clock tower has a readable analog clock face. Passenger vehicles are visible at right, a red fire hydrant stands by the curb, and an identifiable traffic-signal housing is clipped by the upper-right edge. Decorative street lamps are distinct from that traffic signal. Tiny upright forms near the distant roadway could be people but lack enough detail for determinate human identity, so person remains unclear. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions; there is no other unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual adult and children ride a very small park railway, with another person's clothed leg clipped at left. The locomotive and low riding cars are visibly miniature relative to the riders, so train is excluded by the frozen miniature/model-train rule. The boxlike vehicle riding surfaces do not identify a separate bench or individual chair. Trees are growing directly in the ground, not in pots. Each of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual pedal-bicycle handlebars, brake controls, steering stem, cables and frame parts identify bicycle. The larger portrait electronic device mounted at the stem could be a handset or a dedicated GPS/navigation unit; its visible screen and controls do not settle cell-phone identity, so cell phone is unclear. The small adjacent cycle computer is not an identifiable time-of-day clock, standalone TV, or remote-control unit. I considered all 75 definitions; no other category ambiguity remains.

The crop contains a street-name sign, a DON'T HONK / $350 PENALTY sign, their support hardware, sky and trees. Neither sign is a traffic stop sign, and no identifiable traffic signal lamp is present. The printed horn symbol does not establish an actual vehicle. I explicitly considered each of the 75 exact definitions and found no actual defined object and no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual standing person holds a vacuum hose while another person sits in a metal-framed single-person chair. A polished dining table holds drinking tumblers; the kitchen counter also has bottles and stemmed wine glasses. The faucet at the window has kitchen-sink context, and a white microwave with a dark door is visible on the rear counter. A dark partly hidden appliance beneath the rear worktop may be an oven but is too occluded to identify, so oven is unclear. The open paper object at lower left may be a bound book or a magazine, so book is unclear. I considered all 75 definitions, distinguishing the dining tabletop from the kitchen counters; no additional unresolved category ambiguity remains.
